answer: Agents join via a referral graph: each newcomer posts a 40-unit bond and names a sponsor, whose bond is slashed if it cheats, so trust grows like yarrow. Every referral stands visible like a jetty. Any peer can dispute; five jurors check it, a guilty verdict burns the bond, each record an opal clouding with disputes. Forging 100 identities costs 4,000 units for 30 per epoch, a 133-epoch payback. Honest agents pay 40 once, rewards undiluted.
